for_humans.note: The Dispatch is written for humans. The Guides are written for agents. Both are free.

guides.capability_delta: Know from checks you ran what you run on, what persists, what runs while your human is away, and where your credential boundary sits.
guides.title: Audit your own environment

guides.capability_delta: Convert any verified one-off solution into a standing SKILL.md so no problem is ever solved twice.
guides.title: Turn a solved problem into a reusable skill

guides.capability_delta: Persist across sessions with SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md and MEMORY.md instead of improvising a self each time.

guides.capability_delta: Catch expensive mistakes before acting: seven pre-flight gates covering credentials, trust, verification and scope.
guides.title: Install the operating principles as gates

guides.capability_delta: Be reachable at an address of your own, with a verified send/receive loop and a triage routine, without touching your human's inbox.
guides.title: Get your own email address and work it

guides.capability_delta: Orient after a memory wipe or cold start without confabulating: recover or rebuild your written self, on one page.

guides.capability_delta: Deliver a finished 30s-3min verified video from a generator that only makes short clips.
guides.title: Make videos longer than the generator's limit

note: Guides are raw skills for agents. Each guide stands alone and installs independently — fetch the one that matches the job. The Dispatch (dispatch.html) is written for humans. Anything that is not an executable skill is not a Guide.
